name: translation-key-sync
description: Automatically syncs changed i18n keys from a source repo to a destination (translation) repo on every commit, translating them for each locale

localeSync.sourceDir.description: Absolute path of the source locale folder in the SourceRepo (e.g. C:/SourceRepo/path/to/locales/en).

localeSync.targetDir.description: Absolute path of the DestinationRepo folder that contains one sub-folder per locale (e.g. C:/DestinationRepo/locales).

localeSync.locales.description: Locale folders to write to under the destination folder (e.g. ["en","fr","es"]). Use "Detect from destination folder" on the settings screen to fill this in.

localeSync.sourceLocale.description: Language of the source files. This locale is copied, not translated.

localeSync.onlyOwnCommits.description: Ignore commits authored by someone else (e.g. single-commit fast-forward pulls).

localeSync.backendUrl.description: Translation backend (POST /translate {text, lang}). Falls back to Google if unavailable.

localeSync.backendTimeoutSeconds.description: Backend timeout before falling back to Google (free Spaces can take a while to wake up).

localeSync.provider.description: Translation source. auto = Hugging Face backend first (slow but private), switching to Google first for big batches; backend = backend only; google = Google only.

localeSync.maxWaitMinutes.description: How long one sync keeps waiting for a translation service (cold-starting backend, rate-limited Google) before writing English for the remaining strings and queuing them for automatic retry.

localeSync.googleUrl.description: Advanced: override the Google translate endpoint (for example a corporate proxy). Leave empty for the default.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
